provenance.pins: symbol YLED0805R read with tools/eda.py: pin 1 is named + and pin 2 -

designVerdict: NOT FITTED. Costed alternative only: eight plain 0805 indicators on a 74HC595 instead of the SK6812 chain. Recorded so the comparison in the design README can be checked rather than taken on trust.
notes: The comparison it appears in: 0.053 W against 0.120 W, 18 parts against 19-20, and $0.15 against $1.11. Part count is a wash; the decision rests on colour, which became load-bearing when the PD contract gained more states to signal than a single-colour indicator can carry.
